replacement_text: OFAC issued approximately 13-14 civil penalty enforcement actions in 2025 totaling approximately $263M (per Polixis: $262,643,459 across 13 published actions; Sidley Austin rounds to >$265M including 14 actions). Over 81% — $215,988,868 — came from a single penalty against venture capital firm GVA Capital Ltd. for Russia sanctions violations. Two of the 14 actions directly involved freight/logistics operators: Fracht FWO Inc. (Houston-based freight forwarder, $1,610,775 for Venezuela/Iran sanctions violations involving blocked Venezuelan airline aircraft) and Key Holding LLC (Delaware-based logistics firm, $608,825 for Cuba sanctions violations by its Colombian subsidiary). The gamasuite-cited $265M/14-case figure is directionally accurate but should be attributed to OFAC primary records, not that vendor blog. Recommended revised text: 'OFAC imposed approximately $263M in civil penalties across 13-14 enforcement actions in 2025 — including two direct freight/logistics cases — underscoring the agency's sustained focus on supply-chain sanctions compliance (OFAC Civil Penalties, 2025; Sidley Austin 2025 OFAC Year in Review, Feb 2026).'

notes: The gamasuite-cited claim of '$265M across 14 cases' is directionally accurate for full-year 2025 OFAC civil enforcement. Primary OFAC individual action documents were fetched for GVA Capital ($215.99M) and Exodus ($3.1M) via markitdown. The Sidley Austin law firm year-in-review (published February 2026) independently confirms 14 actions and >$265M total. Polixis (sanctions analytics firm) cites $262,643,459 across 13 published actions — the ~$2-3M gap from Sidley's $265M+ figure likely reflects rounding or one additional action. The freight-specific figure is materially smaller: only 2 of the 14 actions involved freight/logistics operators (Fracht FWO at $1.61M and Key Holding at $608K), totaling approximately $2.2M — not $265M. The original claim should be corrected: the $265M figure represents ALL OFAC enforcement sectors, not freight-specific enforcement.
